overall_assessment: Learning outcomes and graded assessment descriptions, including the prose and table variants, were generally intact across all 16 courses. All 12 prerequisite empty flags came from genuine short values, with one stray placeholder in PT1501, and the BTM2001 leak flag came from a wrapped sentence about switching exam routes after the coursework gates had already been extracted. Unflagged errors included coursework requirements filed under teaching methods, a flawed attendance split and misplaced portfolio submission instructions in the BTM2506 control, and assigned readings left in course content in the GT606 control.

findings.evidence: Som et arbeidskrav skal studentene i emnet delta ved en apologetikkonferanse.
findings.description: PT2005's mandatory conference attendance appears only in teaching methods. PT2005, BTM2006 and BTM2010 also repeat the required draft submission there, and PT1501 repeats the required retreat and exercise log. Those gates belong in coursework requirements, alongside the existing details for the ones already recorded there.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The teaching-methods pass in .split_inline_coursework() recognizes established gate and attendance forms, but misses the explicit Som et arbeidskrav lead and the recurring restatements of gates stated more fully elsewhere in the plan.
findings.suggested_fix: Within Fjellhaug's teaching-methods blocks, route sentences beginning Som et arbeidskrav skal to coursework requirements. For the recurring draft-submission sentence, keep the guidance and feedback in teaching methods and use the fuller submission requirement already in coursework requirements when present. Apply the same check to PT1501's retreat and exercise-log requirements.

findings.evidence: Arbeidsmetodene krever aktiv deltakelse fra studentene, som ikke må ha et fravær på mer enn 30%.
findings.description: The BTM2506 control's teaching row consists only of a participation sentence with an explicit 30% absence limit. The preceding sentence describing 40 hours of lectures and seminars was moved in full to coursework requirements because it mentions compulsory attendance. The teaching design and the operative attendance rule are in the wrong rows.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .split_inline_coursework() evaluates attendance one sentence at a time. It matches obligatorisk oppmøte inside the mixed teaching sentence and misses the quantified limit written as a relative clause in the following sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: For Fjellhaug, keep the opening teaching sentence with the lecture and seminar details when it contains med obligatorisk oppmøte and the immediately following sentence sets a numerical absence limit. Move that following sentence verbatim to coursework requirements.

findings.description: The BTM2506 control lists submission instructions for the portfolio tasks as coursework requirements. The final-assessment section identifies those same tasks as the contents of the graded portfolio. The instructions specify what makes up the graded submission, with no separate approval gate stated for those tasks.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Arbeidskrav subheading sets the section before .text_subheadings() switches at Sluttvurdering. That switch does not reassess the preceding submission instructions in light of the graded portfolio wording.
findings.suggested_fix: For Fjellhaug, route the clauses on the number and submission of mappeoppgaver to assessment when the following Sluttvurdering explicitly makes those same tasks the contents of the graded portfolio and the source states no separate approval condition. Keep mandatory attendance in coursework requirements.

findings.description: The GT606 control's subject description includes a separate list of six syllabus options with assigned passages and page counts. The reading list captures the books under Pensumlitteratur but omits the six options.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The reading choices are inside Emnets innhold and the heading reader provides no separate boundary for the lead-in and its passage groups.
findings.suggested_fix: In Fjellhaug's course-content blocks, recognize the lead-in Studenten skal velge ett av de følgende seks tekstområder when followed by named groups with page counts and biblical citations. Route the full group of choices, including the substitution note, to the reading list up to the next main heading.

findings.evidence: Det er faglærer som bestemmer innhold og tidsfrister for gjennomføring av arbeidskrav
findings.description: BTM2503's assessment row starts with a sentence about who defines coursework content and deadlines. The two preceding sentences from the same source paragraph were moved into coursework requirements, leaving their continuation under assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The gate match moves the approval sentence and its antecedent but stops before the next sentence because it does not independently express an exam gate.
findings.suggested_fix: When the Fjellhaug gate pass moves the approval sentences, include the immediately following stock sentence about the instructor setting coursework content and deadlines, with or without final punctuation.

findings.evidence: Ved stryk får studentene anledning til å ta ny eksamen i perioden for ny/utsatt eksamen. Ny eksamen blir gitt som sekstimers hjemmeeksamen.
findings.description: Four alternative-assessment BTM plans retain a stock sentence on access to and timing of the resit next to a separate sentence specifying its form and duration. RLE1007N also keeps a standalone notice about when submission deadlines are announced. These notices are exam logistics.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The institution has no matching entries for these standalone sentences in .logistics_sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Fjellhaug sentence patterns for the exact resit-period notice and the standalone sentence Frister for innleveringer blir kunngjort ved starten av semesteret. Preserve the adjacent resit design and coursework deadlines stated as conditions for exam access.

findings.description: PT1501 appends a standalone Ingen from the recommended-prerequisite block to its required BTM1001. The row contains a real prerequisite and falls below the pre-pass length threshold, as do the 11 other flagged rows with course codes or Latin.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: .strip_placeholder_lines() runs after the prerequisite blocks are joined. It only removes a trailing placeholder paragraph when the preceding text ends in sentence punctuation, which a bare course code lacks.
findings.suggested_fix: Discard placeholder-only required and recommended prerequisite blocks before joining them, then preserve the real course code.
